public_open_space.name: Marathon Plaza
public_open_space.location: In front of building facing Second Street
public_open_space.description: Large, triangular urban garden facing Second Street with a water feature, ample seating, and lush landscaping. Deli and restaurant open to the park provide food and additional seating.
public_open_space.landscaping: Real grass lawns, some planters, large water feature
public_open_space.seating: 33 tables with 66 movable chairs, >200' bench seating
